#cloud-config
hostname: ubuntu-template
users:
  - name: ubuntu
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    shell: /bin/bash
    lock_passwd: false
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-rsa  sk@skhome01
packages:
  - qemu-guest-agent
  - net-tools
  - curl
  - wget
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable qemu-guest-agent
  - systemctl start qemu-guest-agent
  - echo "Cloud-init completed" > /tmp/cloud-init-done
